changelog.summary: Added taxonomyIds to 3 domain(s) — cross-vertical relationship discovery metadata (IDEA-0008 Phase 4), aggregated + alias-resolved from each domain's own question tags. No question/notes/scenario content changed.

Difficulty tagged on all questions; 9 new questions (rulesets layering and bypass modes, CODEOWNERS base-branch rule, script injection, OIDC sub conditions, SHA-pinning policy, push protection bypass, Secret Protection vs Code Security, private vulnerability reporting); 23 existing questions corrected against current GitHub docs (tag rulesets, custom-property targeting, fork token behaviour, job-level timeouts, upload-sarif action, security configurations, machine accounts, PVR); all three domain notes rewritten to the Key Concept / In Practice / Exam Trap standard with Deep Dives and new sections on rulesets, OIDC, script injection, runners, push protection, GHAS products, dependency review and audit log. Correct-answer positions rebalanced (B had been correct in 81%).

Converted the 2 legacy scenarios to RichScenario v2.0 walkthroughs (Migrating Jenkins Pipelines to GitHub Actions: 6 questions on GitHub Actions Importer audit/forecast/dry-run/migrate, Jenkinsfile-to-workflow syntax mapping, OIDC to AWS, reusable workflows with environments, ephemeral ARC runners and deploy concurrency; Securing a Large Monorepo: 6 questions on ruleset and branch protection layering, CODEOWNERS ordering, path-filtered required checks, push protection with delegated bypass, org-required dependency review and tag rulesets). Corrected legacy claims: required checks do not fail open (skipped path-filtered workflows leave them pending), push protection rejects pushes when they are attempted rather than at the client, dependency review gates on fail-on-severity rather than a CVSS score, and tag rulesets prevent deletion rather than making tags recoverable.

D1 notes: added section 1.6 on the ruleset rule "Require workflows to pass before merging" (central workflow file, visibility and access requirements, ignored event filters vs Pending path-filtered checks, Evaluate mode) with matching cheat-sheet, rulesets-table and Deep Dive entries; former 1.6-1.9 renumbered 1.7-1.10. Scenario questionIds now use full bank ids (ghbp-dN-NNN) so all 22 links resolve.
